caseName: Federal Pacific Electric Co. v. City of Kansas City
caseNameFull: Federal Pacific Electric Co. v. City of Kansas City, Missouri
attorneys: Ralph M. Jones, Charles B. Blackmar, James C. Wilson and Sheridan Morgan for petitioners. Keith Wilson, Jr. for respondent. Richard C. Coburn and Alan C. Kohn for Union Electric Co., as amicus curiae, in opposition.

opinions.text: Motion of Union Electric Co. for leave- to file a brief, as amicus curiae, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.
